verdict.rationale: Bolna's API lets you fetch call transcripts (bolna-docs-14) and the platform can be self-hosted via Docker/Kubernetes (bolna-docs-9), with an open-source core framework (bolna-gh-1), which together provide some data portability, but there is no documented bulk 'export all data' feature or guarantee of open, standard export formats covering call recordings, agent configs, analytics, etc. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export tool/endpoint, documented open format specification for exported data, and independent confirmation that a user can fully migrate away with all their data.
